integrity.source_boundary: The 2026 source states the two global-maximizer candidates and their proposed switch at dimension six, but does not state their local Hessian spectra or the bistable window.

limitations: At \(n=8\), the sparse candidate has one quadratic null direction whose higher-order sign is not classified.
The dense-candidate Hessian is claimed only for \(4\le n\le8\); no extrapolation beyond that range is asserted.

scientific.main_invariant: The spherical Hessian of \(\log\Phi_n\) at the two normal vectors proposed in the recent maximizer conjecture.
scientific.object: Central hyperplane sections of the cross-polytope whose hyperplane contains the barycenter of a fixed facet.

title: Exact local Hessian phase diagram for two conjectural cross-polytope section maximizers
